c74object.name: bachmcp.translate
c74object.digest: Convert scores between bach and dictionaries
c74object.description: Converts a bach.roll score to a dictionary (bachjson-complete) and back, without losing anything, and translates files with read and readwrite. The dictionary has an optional header (clefs, keys, voicenames, markers, slotinfo...) and voices > chords (onset, notes) > notes (pitch, dur, vel, and optionally breakpoints, slots, articulations, name, flag). Times in ms, pitches in midicents (6000 = middle C). Every direction works, json to json and llll to llll included: they come out checked and in bach's order. Full specification: bachjson-syntax-specification.md.

outlet.digest: Score in the @to format, or a message passed through (@transparent 1)

method.name: llll
method.description: A score in bach.roll's gathered syntax, when from is llll (native) or t (text).

method.name: dictionary
method.description: A score as a dictionary, when from is json.

method.name: read
method.description: Reads a file and sends it, translated, out of the left outlet in the to format. A file is JSON when its first character is {, whatever its extension; anything else is read as bach text.

method.name: readwrite
method.digest: Translate a file into a file
method.description: Translates a file into another, then sends readwrite done out of the right outlet. Without out the result goes next to in with the same name: a JSON file becomes <name>.txt (bach text), a bach file <name>.json. An out ending in .json is written as JSON, any other as bach text.

method.name: anything
method.description: With transparent 1, any message that is not a native llll or dictionary <name> (a bang, a number, dump...) goes out of the outlet unchanged. With transparent 0 it is refused with an error. With from t every message is read as a text llll, so nothing is passed through.

attribute.name: from
attribute.description: llll: native bach llll. t: text llll. json: a dictionary.

attribute.name: to
attribute.description: json: a dictionary this object owns, filled again at every output. llll: native bach llll. t: text llll (Max's message limit applies).

attribute.name: transparent
attribute.description: 1 (default): messages that are not a native llll or a dictionary go out of the outlet unchanged. 0: only lllls and dictionaries are taken.

attribute.name: merge_onset_chords
attribute.digest: One chord per onset in each voice
attribute.description: 1: in each voice, the chords with the same onset go out as one chord (the first one's, then the others' notes, in order). 0 (default): chords as they came. It applies to every output: the outlet, read and readwrite.

attribute.name: label
attribute.value: One Chord Per Onset In Each Voice

attribute.name: force_json_as_txt
attribute.description: readwrite: 1 writes JSON into .txt names instead; without out, <name>.txt, so a bach .txt file is replaced by its JSON.
